sheets.accuracy: Manual boundary picks, no independently surveyed landmarks. Residuals measure grid fit only. Source datum assumed, not verified; provisional georeferencing.
sheets.limitations: Approximate color segmentation, not interpreted contacts. Hatches/text are not independently classified. Similar colors list candidates. Provisional georeferencing, not field-grade. 178 sampled shared-legend swatches are native-image references, not transcribed or uniquely identified units. Candidate lists are not exhaustive.
